summary: Frontend-only verification of Split System brand pages restructure (4 manufacturer pages). All requested checks pass: brand nav shows exactly 4 cards with correct brand names (no 'undefined'), each manufacturer page renders correct range sections + pricing tables (Daikin Cora/Alira X, Rinnai PB/T, Mitsubishi Electric AP, MHI Ciara), BOOK INSTALLATION pre-fill flow populates QuoteForm message, submit label, and selection summary correctly with '$1,700 · Supplied & Installed' for Cora 3.5kW. Sitemap.xml contains the 4 new manufacturer URLs and none of the old range-level slugs. Regression pages (/ducted /cleaning /repairs /servicing /) all 200. Gallery rotated tiles 7-10 retain rotate-90 class.
critical_code_review_comments: BrandPage.jsx uses `data-testid=price-row-{slug}-{kw.replace(/[^0-9a-z]/gi,'')}` — the /i flag makes it case-insensitive but the `a-z` char class only matches lowercase, so uppercase letters (like 'W' in 'kW') are preserved. Resulting testids are e.g. 'price-row-cora-25kW'. Works, but the intent stated in the review request ('35kw') doesn't match reality ('35kW'). Consider adding `.toLowerCase()` for consistent lowercase testids and to match the documented convention.
SPLIT_BRANDS still exports a `label` field identical to `brand` — dead field, safe to remove.
Daikin H1 shows only 'Daikin Split System Air Conditioning' (single H1), which is correct — no 'undefined' anywhere. Bug fix verified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Brand pricing kW slug case is UPPERCASE 'kW' (e.g. book-btn-cora-35kW) due to /[^0-9a-z]/gi regex — use exact casing in Playwright selectors. Lenis smooth scroll requires ~3s wait after click before form field values are ready.
